keyFindings.description: This round added the sentence 'A fanout delivery that fails to a *live* session still NAKs through its own outcome's exceptionFailureRetries.' That mechanism cannot execute. exceptionFailureRetries is read only at delivery.go:255, inside the exception-publication branch whose guard at :249 is isControlTopic(item.Topic) || outcome.fanoutRefusal; its sole setter at :990 is the generic fanout outcome, which does not set fanoutRefusal, and listenerDeliveryHandler routes both control prefixes elsewhere (:300-306) so a fanout topic is never a control topic. The live retry on that path is retry: retryable at :991 and the final finalize(true) at :1012-1014 - which the very next bullet of the same file already states correctly, so the new sentence is both false and redundant. New this round: the phrase is absent from packages/envoy/AGENTS.md at refs/heads/main, read there rather than from a patch series. It is one sentence, it needs no code change, and the correct mechanism is named above. Raised because this is the class this change has been held to five times, in the file every agent working this repository loads, and because the round that deleted one dead path wrote a new claim attributing behaviour to a different dead field.

The cancellation window is narrowed, not closed, and the body entry that said it was closed is corrected by the reviewer rather than sent back. ensureConnWithContext is a loop whose top returns nil on a connected or draining connection without consulting ctx; its ctx.Done() arm sits only in the select taken when the connection is down but not closed, beside a 10 ms timer that can win Go's random choice when both are ready; and a successful connectWithContext installs and returns nil whatever the context did meanwhile. publishCoreTo then reaches publishConfirmed, which is handed only the deadline and publishes. About one 10 ms tick. The mild end of the class, since the caller has cancelled and so is not told failure and does not retry. Both thermonuclear passes reached this interleaving independently. The architect's ruling - closed only by a test, else recorded - stands, so it stays in Not proven / risk, narrowed.

The architect asked for a verdict on deliveryOutcome.exceptionFailureRetries rather than an observation. Verdict: pre-existing, not this change's. It is unreachable by the same complement that condemned the deleted helper - sole setter at :990 without fanoutRefusal, guard at :249 - but packages/envoy/cmd/listener/delivery.go read at refs/heads/main carries the identical field, reader, sole setter and routing complement, so the cutover did not make it dead. Recorded in Not proven / risk with its two line references for the architect to route; the merge is not held for it. Both thermonuclear passes independently reached the same provenance.

The cancellation test releases after a 300 ms sleep rather than on a handshake at the wait's entry, so it is a reliable lock on the outage case and not a deterministic proof of every cancellation/reconnect interleaving. Named by the code-quality pass, agreed, and recorded in Not proven / risk beside the residual above.
